main.description: Notify that a repo in a space has advanced. Repo hosts reliably deliver their latest state to the space host, which sequences updates and forwards them to registered syncers with reasonable-effort delivery. Authenticated with service auth.

repo.description: The DID of the account whose repo advanced.

repoRev.description: The repo revision after the write.

data.description: The repo's current commit data (sha256 of the LtHash state) after the write. Lets the space host maintain each repo's commit data for listRepos.

spaceRev.description: The space revision assigned by the space host. Present only on notifications forwarded to syncers.

prevSpaceRev.description: The previous space revision. Omitted on the first update in a space. A gap indicates missed notifications; recover using listRepos with cursor.

errors.name: FutureRev
errors.description: The repo revision exceeds the permitted clock skew.
